behavior: GW-34..GW-43 reuse the existing governed GitHub, task-transition and governed-session checkpoint authorities without introducing a second GitHub or task authority.
Review evidence is commit/head bound; stale or mismatched review evidence fails closed when policy requires approvals and unresolved required threads remain blockers.
PremergeProof composes existing GitHub/task/session evidence without re-observing and is bound to exact head, pull request and repository.
PremergeProof is additionally bound to taskId/taskRevision, governedSessionId/sessionRevision, bootstrapReceiptId and stateVersion before GW-42 can plan MERGE_READY.
GW-43 refuses a proof for another head, pull request or repository and plans only the existing governed exact-head merge capability.
Exact-head merge remains NON_REPLAYABLE_RECOVER_BY_OBSERVATION and no merge is executed by candidate evaluation code.
